CITY OF INGLEWOOD

  September 16, 2020 6:30 p.m.
  Via Zoom

  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social distancing
measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-
29-20 ((https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp- content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-
EO.pdf)), please note that members of the public will only be allowed to observe
and address the Arts Commission Meeting of September 16, 2020 at 6:30 P.M.
by telephone or video as follows:

Members of the public who wish to listen, view and or orally address the Arts
Commission must use the public access options noted below:

Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:
   Members of the public may view, listen and make oral public comments
  telephonically by:

  View, Listen and Comments

  Visit zoom.us/join. Meeting ID: 819 4449 8713 Passcode: 580963
  One tap mobile - +16699006833,,81944498713#,,,,,,0#,,580963#

  Listen only and Comments

  Dial +1 669 900 6833 Meeting ID: 819 4449 8713  Passcode: 580963

Please observe the following tips when phoning in:

    When you log-in/call-in, except for meeting presenters and speakers, all
  microphones and video cameras will be muted/off.
    When you are making public comments, you line will be unmuted.

  Written Public Comments: Members of the public can submit comments for
  consideration by the Arts Commission by sending them to Stephanie Maldondado,
  Senior Management Assistant, at smaldonado@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
  distribution to the members of the Arts Commission prior to consideration of the
  agenda, comments must be received prior to 12:00 P.M. on September 16, 2020,
  the day of the meeting. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and
  agenda item. Comments received after 12:00 P.M. will be made part of the official
  public record of the meeting.

minutes_text:
INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  ARTS COMMISSION

The Arts Commission meeting was held on Wednesday, September 16, 2020 via ZOOM. Commissioner Metcalf
called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Roll Call

  Present
  Commissioner Jacques Lesure, Commissioner at Large
  Commissioner Aletha Metcalf, District 1
  Commissioner Onna Ehrlich-Bell, District 2
  Commissioner Phyllis Battle, District 3
  Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks, District 4
  Sabrina Barnes, Director, Parks, Recreation and Community Services Department
  Helen Lessick, Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado, Senior Management Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Commissioner Lessure made a motion to approve the minutes from July 22, 2020. Commissioner Battle
seconded and the minutes were approved as follows:

  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Battle, Lessure, Ehrlich-Bell and Banks
  Nays: None

Special Presentation

  Shelly Heffler gave a presentation regarding the “Community Quilt Project”.

Staff Report

  Stephanie Maldonado introduced a staff report recommending the Arts Commission recommend the City
Manager approve an agreement in the amount of $27,291 for a contract with the art conservation firm RLA for
conservation services for Skedans, Tony Delap’s monumental artwork, located at Inglewood City Hall. Helen Lessick
gave an over view of the staff report.

  1
   INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  ARTS COMMISSION

  Commissioner Banks made a motion to approve the staff report. Commissioner Metcalf seconded and the
staff report was approved as follows:

  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Battle, Lessure, Ehrlich-Bell and Banks
  Nays: None

  Sabrina Barnes and Helen Lessick presented a report regarding City of Inglewood Cultural Arts Support (for
receive and file only).

Verbal Reports

  Ms. Lessick gave verbal reports regarding the following art related projects:

  a) National Endowment for the arts: Arts Engagement in American Communities Grant Award to the City
  of Inglewood for Rogers Park Artist in Residence (RPAiR)
  b) Recognition of Inglewood Arts + Culture:
   September 3, 2020: Crenshaw Dairy Mart, ABC 7 Community Report
   July 28, 2020: Hyperallergic.com: online arts reporting from Brooklyn, New York

Public Comments

  None

Commissioners’ Comments/Initiatives/Art Calendar

  Next Arts Commission Meeting is scheduled for October 21, 2020 at 6:30 p.m. via ZOOM.

With no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:21 p.m.
